source: Iced-Cream's own tests on their unit, two runs of build KBH7 on 2026-11-08: elkbench plans KBH F1, T1 and F2 (r-bf3d20, r-05d8db, r-0ef22c), then F1, T2 and F2 (r-4c42e5, r-3a1a42, r-5cff4c), each gated in the emulator on the same PC
statement: On an Analog Rytm MKII with OS 1.74 and this package on Modwerk's base (core-ar2 0.7, plain variant ba530f45, with analoghealth 1.2 for remote keys), build KBH7, 2026-11-08, through the KIT menu's RELOAD: KIT menu RELOAD twice on an unedited kit: KIT RELOADED! both times, saved BD DEC kept (screen). BD DEC turned to 0; RELOAD: KIT RELOADED! with the saved DEC; RELOAD again: EDITS RESTORED! with DEC at 0 (screens). After RELOAD armed the A/B, DEC turned to 127; RELOAD: KIT RELOADED! (not EDITS RESTORED!) with the saved DEC; RELOAD again: EDITS RESTORED! with DEC at 127, not the stashed 0 (screens). After DEC to 0 and RELOAD armed the A/B, KIT menu LOAD KIT loaded kit 2; two RELOADs then both showed KIT RELOADED! on kit 2, never EDITS RESTORED! (screens; second run, 2026-11-08 23:01). CPU 74-77 %, heap flat. NO + PLAY MODE has not been run on the unit yet.
scope: kit-ab 1.0.0 on Modwerk's base (KBH7), through the KIT menu's RELOAD. Not covered: NO + PLAY MODE on the unit (pending), persistence.

builds.label: KBH7
builds.content: Stock OS 1.74 + Modwerk base for core-ar2 0.7 (plain variant ba530f45) + analoghealth 1.2 (remote keys, test harness; no site shared with this module) + kit-ab 1.0.0, linked by scripts/link-image.mjs. Driven by elkbench plans after their emulator gate; stock 1.74 restored at the end.
results: KIT menu RELOAD twice on an unedited kit: KIT RELOADED! both times, saved BD DEC kept (screen).
BD DEC turned to 0; RELOAD: KIT RELOADED! with the saved DEC; RELOAD again: EDITS RESTORED! with DEC at 0 (screens).
After RELOAD armed the A/B, DEC turned to 127; RELOAD: KIT RELOADED! (not EDITS RESTORED!) with the saved DEC; RELOAD again: EDITS RESTORED! with DEC at 127, not the stashed 0 (screens).
CPU 76.6 / 76.2 %, DSP 70.1 / 70.0 %, heap flat, two readings 30 s apart after the flash.
After DEC to 0 and RELOAD armed the A/B, KIT menu LOAD KIT loaded kit 2; two RELOADs then both showed KIT RELOADED! on kit 2, never EDITS RESTORED! (screens; second run, 2026-11-08 23:01).
Second run: CPU 74.7 / 74.2 %, DSP 70.0 / 69.8 %, heap flat after the flash.
notRun: NO + PLAY MODE, stock's kit reload key, has not been run on the unit yet (pending). The runs' remote NO(PLAY) pressed transport PLAY, which is not the reload gesture; the KIT menu's RELOAD calls the same kit_ab_toggle.
A power cycle (the stash is not kept, by design) was not run.

coverageDetails.duration: about 7 minutes per run (flash to stock restore), two runs
individualTestResults: Unedited kit: two RELOADs are plain reloads
Edit, RELOAD, RELOAD: KIT RELOADED! then EDITS RESTORED!
An edit while the saved kit plays ends the A/B
A change of kit ends the A/B (second run)
NO + PLAY MODE: pending on the unit

contextNote: Main OS hash is the build's, not read back from the device. The first run's T1 is recorded as failed in its last section, on a kit-list reference that compared screen content the plan does not control; the second run's T2 covered that section with the check narrowed to the cursor row, and passed.
